zh-CN.title: 小程序广场与投稿融为一体
items: 微信小程序现在可从广场标题直接切换投稿，无需离开当前页面
我的投稿与审批沿用广场页签布局，并汇总展示待处理提醒

en.title: Square and Submissions now share one mini program workspace
items: The WeChat mini program now switches between Square and Submissions from the shared title without leaving the page
My Submissions and Review use the same tab layout and surface combined pending alerts
